constraints.name: dispatch_receipts_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'claimed'::text) AND (lease_token_sha256 IS NULL) AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL)) OR (status <> 'claimed'::text)))

constraints.name: dispatch_receipts_factory_source_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((event_kind = 'quest_authoring_compile'::text) AND (renderer_version = 'mission-factory-quest-authoring/1'::text) AND (quest_compile_request IS NOT NULL) AND (master_session_id IS NULL) AND (authority_receipt_id = quest_compile_request) AND (request_key = quest_compile_request) AND (legacy_combat_receipt_id IS NULL)) OR ((event_kind <> 'quest_authoring_compile'::text) AND (renderer_version <> 'mission-factory-quest-authoring/1'::text) AND (quest_compile_request IS NULL) AND (master_session_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: dispatch_receipts_legacy_combat_receipt_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (legacy_combat_receipt_id) REFERENCES mission_run_canary_combat_receipts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: dispatch_receipts_master_session_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (master_session_id) REFERENCES master_v2_sessions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: dispatch_receipts_quest_compile_request_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (quest_compile_request) REFERENCES mission_factory_owner.quest_compile_requests(request_key) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: staff_ai_quota_terminal_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((state = ANY (ARRAY['settled'::text, 'over_cap'::text])) AND (charged_usd IS NOT NULL) AND (settled_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((state = ANY (ARRAY['reserved'::text, 'sent'::text, 'unknown_billable'::text, 'no_http'::text])) AND (charged_usd IS NULL))))
